findings.text: issue (blocking): §5 tells build to call loom-code:review when this is the last wave, before execution reaches §6.5, while §6.5 says the memory work must precede that same closing round; following the numbered sections causes the post-review memory commit Acceptance 1–2 eliminate.
findings.fix: Move the final-wave review call after package tests and the memory step, or make §5 defer the last-wave call until §6 and §6.5 have completed; name the resulting call scope: branch-end when the final wave-end round doubles as branch-end.

findings.text: issue (blocking): build requires the plan's reserved last-wave memory task, but write-plan and its plan template never require or create it; a future plan reaches §6.5 without a valid task id and any graduated-test commit fails push.dispatch-covers-tasks.
findings.fix: Add the reservation to write-plan's plan-shape contract and plan template, or make build create the task and dispatch record through a documented mechanism.

findings.text: issue (blocking): the station-text tests prove only that the memory heading precedes hand-off, not that it precedes the final-wave review call in §5, so the sequencing contradiction stays green.

findings.fix: Add a sentence to write-plan's Shape section reserving a last-wave memory task, or soften §6.5 and state what to do when none exists.
